name: Godrej Bliss
description: Godrej Bliss is a high-rise residential development in Kandivali East, Mumbai, developed by Shivam Developers with Godrej Properties as development manager. It offers 2 & 3 BHK homes with decks, and 40+ amenities spread across ground, podium, and rooftop levels.
curation: Amenities arranged over three levels: Ground Greens, an Active Podium, and a Rooftop Rejuvenation level with the Skyscape gym
About 1.5 acres of open green space across the combined Godrej Bliss and Godrej Nest layout
Godrej Properties is the development manager and Shivam Developers is the developer of record, which is worth noting during due diligence
connectivity: 7 min drive to the Western Express Highway
7 min drive to Akurli Metro station
10 min drive to Kandivali railway station
6 min drive to Lokhandwala Foundation School
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: High-rise towers framed by trees at sunset
